scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,ui -c blue,magenta --kill-others "STAFFROOM_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5317 pnpm --filter @staffroom/server dev" "pnpm --filter @staffroom/ui dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @staffroom/server build && pnpm --filter @staffroom/ui build && pnpm --filter @staffroom/cli build
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm --filter @staffroom/server build && pnpm --filter @staffroom/server build:desktop && pnpm --filter @staffroom/ui build
scripts.desktop:install: pnpm build:desktop && STAFF_PACK_SKIP_NOTARIZE=1 pnpm --filter @staffroom/desktop run pack && pnpm --filter @staffroom/desktop run install:app
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -n ui,desktop -c magenta,cyan --kill-others "STAFFROOM_UI_PORT=5328 pnpm --filter @staffroom/ui dev" "STAFFROOM_DESKTOP_DEV_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5328 pnpm --filter @staffroom/desktop start"
scripts.check: pnpm -r check && pnpm test && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check
